subject: Rye Inc MAP: security gate checklist, DPA redline, and close timeline
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Jake Miller <jake.miller@ryeinc.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Rye Inc MAP: security gate checklist, DPA redline, and close timeline

Hi Jake —

Great speaking yesterday. Per our call, I wanted to kickoff a concise mutual action plan (MAP) that surfaces the security/compliance gates Rye is tracking so we can lock an evaluation window and path to sign. High-level asks from your side that I captured: SOC 2 report (latest), SIG/CAIQ matrix, DPA (redline), and confirmation on data retention / residency.

Attached is a short SOC 2 summary and a starter SIG/CAIQ export for Rye to review. Proposed MAP milestones (suggested timeline):
- Week 0 (Apr 19): Intake meeting + legal & procurement alignment
- Week 1 (Apr 26): DPA redline exchange + SIG/CAIQ Qs answered
- Week 2 (May 3): Evidence review (SOC 2 artifacts) — Redwood shares scrubbed logs/samples as permitted
- Week 3 (May 10): Final security signoff / contract exec window

Quick clarifications we need from you to lock the schedule:
1) Desired retention default (30/60/90 days) for indexed model inputs — you mentioned 60 in passing, confirm if that’s firm.
2) Any strict EU residency requirement? We can route eval traffic to us-east or eu-west regions.
3) Primary contact for legal/procurement (cc them if convenient).

Attachments: [Attachment: soc2-report-summary.pdf (PDF, 120KB)], [Attachment: sig-caiq-matrix.xlsx (XLSX, 85KB)].

Next step: if you’re ok with the milestones above, I’ll loop in Kimberly (security) and Ben (solutions) to detail evidence owners and a narrow checklist so we don’t over-index.

Thanks —
Jordan
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[jordan.blake@redwood.com]

From: Jake Miller <jake.miller@ryeinc.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@ryeinc.com>, Rye Inc Procurement <procurement@ryeinc.com>, Rye Inc Legal <legal@ryeinc.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Rye Inc MAP: security gate checklist, DPA redline, and close timeline

Jordan —

Thanks for the recap and the artifacts. We want to keep this tight — target is internal procurement approval by May 12 so we can include Redwood in our POC cohort for June. A few clarifications from our side:

- Retention: we prefer a 60-day default for unstructured inputs, with the option to request shorter windows for sensitive data. Is that supported?
- Residency: Rye requires EU residency for any production PII, but the evaluation can run from US for now. Will need a plan for prod routing.
- SIG: can you confirm if the CAIQ has been updated to reflect your latest key-management and encryption practices?

Kimberly / Ben — I’m cc’ing our procurement and legal teams; procurement will own commercial cadence and legal will take the DPA redline.

Jake Miller
Director, Platform Integrations, RyE Inc
[jake.miller@ryeinc.com]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Jake Miller <jake.miller@ryeinc.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Rye Inc MAP: security gate checklist, DPA redline, and close timeline

Hi Jake — looping in next-level detail on the MAP and evidence routing. Thanks for confirming the 60-day preference — we can set 60 days as the default for eval logs/inputs and offer a configurable retention flag during onboarding. For EU residency in production: Redwood supports model routing to eu-west region and can enable EU-only persistence for PII candidates.

On your SIG/CAIQ question: the attached CAIQ is the up-to-date export and calls out KMS/HSM usage, envelope encryption, and our SOC 2 scope. We will also provide a short tech appendix that maps CAIQ questions to concrete artifacts for the evidence review.

Proposed, slightly more detailed MAP milestones with owners:
- Apr 19 (Intake): Jordan (AE) + Jake (RyE) + Procurement kickoff — owner: Procurement (RyE) & Jordan
- Apr 26 (DPA redline): RyE Legal to send redline by Apr 26; Redwood legal to respond by Apr 30 — owner: Legal teams
- May 3 (Evidence review): Redwood security (Kimberly) to share SOC 2 artifact index; RyE Security to request samples by May 6 — owner: Kimberly / RyE Sec
- May 10 (Signoff window): Procurement & Legal final checks; contingency signoff by May 17 if additional items remain — owner: Procurement / Jordan

I’ve attached the CAIQ export and a short evidence index spreadsheet that maps each MAP checklist item to an internal Redwood owner. Attachments: [Attachment: sig-caiq-matrix.xlsx], [Attachment: evidence-index-for-rye.csv].

If procurement sends a commercial milestone (SOW/payment terms) I’ll coordinate the evidence delivery cadence to avoid blocking you.

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Head of Security Partnerships, Redwood Inference
[kimberly.park@redwood.com]

From: Rye Inc Legal <legal@ryeinc.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Jake Miller <jake.miller@ryeinc.com>, Rye Inc Procurement <procurement@ryeinc.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Rye Inc MAP: security gate checklist, DPA redline, and close timeline

On Fri, Apr 16, 2027 at 08:21 AM Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com> wrote:
> I’ve attached the CAIQ export and a short evidence index spreadsheet that maps each MAP checklist item to an internal Redwood owner.

Thanks for the clarity. Please find attached our DPA redline (short form) — key asks from legal: 1) confirmation of EU residency option for prod PII, 2) 60-day default retention for evaluation artifacts (with discrete exceptions), 3) contractual commitment on access logging and audit traceability. We also asked for a KMS/escrow note in section 4.2.

We can accommodate a compressed review cycle if Redwood confirms by Apr 30 on the DPA redline and provides the SOC 2 artifact index by May 3. We will start procurement review concurrently.

Attachments: [Attachment: dpa-redline-ryeinc.docx (DOCX, 45KB)].

Regards,
Rye Inc Legal
legal@ryeinc.com
